subject.title: Add Rovo Dev provider with monthly credit tracking

question: Should CodexBar ship this experimental provider before Atlassian's site-selection contract for `credits/check` is authoritatively verified?
rationale: The endpoint and its Cloud-ID transport are undocumented; source inspection and CI cannot establish whether the provider reports the correct allowance for entitled multi-site users.

options.title: Verify the contract before merge
options.body: Obtain authoritative protocol evidence or an entitled multi-site exact-head run, implement the confirmed site selection, and keep the feature experimental.

options.title: Narrow to a supported local source
options.body: Replace the undocumented direct request with a supported ACLI/local-config parsing path if it can provide durable and testable usage data.

options.title: Accept the experimental limitation
options.body: Merge only if the repository owner explicitly accepts that some configured users may see unavailable or incorrect site-scoped credit data.

recommendation.title: Verify the contract before merge
recommendation.body: Obtain authoritative protocol evidence or an entitled multi-site exact-head run, implement the confirmed site selection, and keep the feature experimental.

likelyOwner.reason: He performed the latest provider hardening pass and explicitly paused merge for the unresolved external protocol contract.
